references.text: Psalm 24:1 emphasizes that everything belongs to the Lord, which resonates with Jesus' message of giving to God what is God's
Deuteronomy 10:14 confirms that the heavens and the earth belong to the Lord, paralleling the idea of giving God what is God's
Paul's letter to the Romans 13:7 urges us to give everyone what they are owed, a principle similar to giving to Caesar what is Caesar's
James' letter 4:17 speaks about doing what is right, which can be understood in light of giving to God what is God's
